annotations.title: Convert JSON to XLSX or CSV

description: Write a loaded document out as linked tables — one .xlsx workbook, or a .zip of CSVs — by running a frozen converter spec deterministically. The spec comes from draft_spec, reviewed or edited: pass it inline as spec or as a file in specPath, exactly one of the two. format overrides the format the spec names. Returns row/skipped/warning counts, never the output rows. An existing outPath is refused unless overwrite=true. For one query's result as a single CSV or JSONL file, use export_result instead.

overwrite.description: Replace outPath only when explicitly true.

specPath.description: Path to a converter spec; use either this or spec.

name: convert
